entries.title: Luke 24:1
segments: ¶But on the morrow of the sabbath, very early indeed in the morning, they came to the tomb, bringing the aromatic spices which they had prepared.

entries.title: Luke 24:2
segments: And they found the stone rolled away from the sepulchre.

entries.title: Luke 24:3
segments: And when they had entered they found not the body of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 24:4
segments: And it came to pass as they were in perplexity about it, that behold, two men suddenly stood by them in shining raiment.

entries.title: Luke 24:5
segments: And as they were filled with fear and bowed their faces to the ground, they said to them, Why seek ye the living one among the dead?

entries.title: Luke 24:6
segments: He is not here, but is risen: remember how he spoke to you, being yet in Galilee,

entries.title: Luke 24:7
segments: saying, The Son of man must be delivered up into the hands of sinners, and be crucified, and rise the third day.

entries.title: Luke 24:8
segments: And they remembered his words;

entries.title: Luke 24:9
segments: and, returning from the sepulchre, related all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

entries.title: Luke 24:10
segments: Now it was Mary of Magdala, and Johanna, and Mary the [mother] of James, and the others with them, who told these things to the apostles.

entries.title: Luke 24:11
segments: And their words appeared in their eyes as an idle tale, and they disbelieved them.

entries.title: Luke 24:12
segments: But Peter, rising up, ran to the sepulchre, and stooping down he sees the linen clothes lying there alone, and went away home, wondering at what had happened.

entries.title: Luke 24:13
segments: ¶And behold, two of them were going on the same day to a village distant sixty stadia from Jerusalem, called Emmaus;

entries.title: Luke 24:14
segments: and they conversed with one another about all these things which had taken place.

entries.title: Luke 24:15
segments: And it came to pass as they conversed and reasoned, that Jesus himself drawing nigh, went with them;

entries.title: Luke 24:16
segments: but their eyes were holden so as not to know him.

entries.title: Luke 24:17
segments: And he said to them, What discourses are these which pass between you as ye walk, and are downcast?

entries.title: Luke 24:18
segments: And one [of them], named Cleopas, answering said to him, Thou sojournest alone in Jerusalem, and dost not know what has taken place in it in these days?

entries.title: Luke 24:19
segments: And he said to them, What things? And they said to him, The things concerning Jesus the Nazaraean, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

entries.title: Luke 24:20
segments: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to [the] judgment of death and crucified him.

entries.title: Luke 24:21
segments: But *we* had hoped that *he* was [the one] who is about to redeem Israel. But then, besides all these things, it is now, to-day, the third day since these things took place.

entries.title: Luke 24:22
segments: And withal, certain women from amongst us astonished us, having been very early at the sepulchre,

entries.title: Luke 24:23
segments: and, not having found his body, came, saying that they also had seen a vision of angels, who say that he is living.

entries.title: Luke 24:24
segments: And some of those with us went to the sepulchre, and found it so, as the women also had said, but him they saw not.

entries.title: Luke 24:25
segments: And *he* said to them, O senseless and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

entries.title: Luke 24:26
segments: Ought not the Christ to have suffered these things and to enter into his glory?

entries.title: Luke 24:27
segments: And having begun from Moses and from all the prophets, he interpreted to them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself.

entries.title: Luke 24:28
segments: And they drew near to the village where they were going, and *he* made as though he would go farther.

entries.title: Luke 24:29
segments: And they constrained him, saying, Stay with us, for it is toward evening and the day is declining. And he entered in to stay with them.

entries.title: Luke 24:30
segments: And it came to pass as he was at table with them, having taken the bread, he blessed, and having broken it, gave it to them.

entries.title: Luke 24:31
segments: And their eyes were opened, and they recognised him. And he disappeared from them.

entries.title: Luke 24:32
segments: And they said to one another, Was not our heart burning in us as he spoke to us on the way, [and] as he opened the scriptures to us?

entries.title: Luke 24:33
segments: And rising up the same hour, they returned to Jerusalem. And they found the eleven, and those with them, gathered together,

entries.title: Luke 24:34
segments: saying, The Lord is indeed risen and has appeared to Simon.

entries.title: Luke 24:35
segments: And they related what [had happened] on the way, and how he was made known to them in the breaking of bread.

entries.title: Luke 24:36
segments: ¶And as they were saying these things, he himself stood in their midst, and says to them, Peace [be] unto you.

entries.title: Luke 24:37
segments: But they, being confounded and being frightened, supposed they beheld a spirit.

entries.title: Luke 24:38
segments: And he said to them, Why are ye troubled? and why are thoughts rising in your hearts?

entries.title: Luke 24:39
segments: behold my hands and my feet, that it is *I* myself. Handle me and see, for a spirit has not flesh and bones as ye see me having.

entries.title: Luke 24:40
segments: And having said this he shewed them his hands and his feet.

entries.title: Luke 24:41
segments: But while they yet did not believe for joy, and were wondering, he said to them, Have ye anything here to eat?

entries.title: Luke 24:42
segments: And they gave him part of a broiled fish and of a honeycomb;

entries.title: Luke 24:43
segments: and he took it and ate before them.

entries.title: Luke 24:44
segments: And he said to them, These [are] the words which I spoke to you while I was yet with you, that all that is written concerning me in the law of Moses and prophets and psalms must be fulfilled.

entries.title: Luke 24:45
segments: Then he opened their understanding to understand the scriptures,

entries.title: Luke 24:46
segments: and said to them, Thus it is written, and thus it behoved the Christ to suffer, and to rise from among the dead the third day;

entries.title: Luke 24:47
segments: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations beginning at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 24:48
segments: And *ye* are witnesses of these things.

entries.title: Luke 24:49
segments: And behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you; but do ye remain in the city till ye be clothed with power from on high.

entries.title: Luke 24:50
segments: ¶And he led them out as far as Bethany, and having lifted up his hands, he blessed them.

entries.title: Luke 24:51
segments: And it came to pass as he was blessing them, he was separated from them and was carried up into heaven.

entries.title: Luke 24:52
segments: And *they*, having done him homage, returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

entries.title: Luke 24:53
segments: and were continually in the temple praising and blessing God.
